metadata.snapshotPolicy: Latest CLOB five-minute sample in the 24 hours strictly before each local midnight (04:00 UTC, EDT). Prices are not normalized. No post-cutoff samples used.
metadata.historyPolicy: Up to eight evenly spaced entries selected from each available pre-cutoff series, preserving original timestamps and prices. This is a downsampled price history, not a trade-by-trade tape.
metadata.resolutionProvider: Weather Underground, per each event's rules. Settlement prices from closed Gamma markets are separate from the pre-event snapshot.
